instruction: A single slim katana whose blade is matte black composite with a razor edge of exposed circuitry glowing electric cyan along the entire length. The wrap on the hilt is cracked synthetic leather in oxblood over a hexagonal carbon-fiber core, and the tsuba is a notched steel disc studded with a magenta status LED. Fine holographic decals and a thin data cable coil near the pommel.
